skills.name: Heaven's Envy
skills.text: Whenever Guo Jia flips a judgement card, he places into his hand before it takes effect.

skills.name: Bestowed Rouse
skills.text: For each unit of damage that Guo Jia receives, he draws two cards. He can then distribute these cards in any way that he sees fit among the characters in play.

source.site: English Sanguosha (Jason Keeney and Scott Maresh)
